data.one_liner: A Flutter widget and controller to manage, browse, and pick files and folders.
data.what_it_does: Provides a FileManager widget and FileManagerController to display file system entities in a list, navigate directories, sort files by various parameters, and handle folder creation and file access permissions.
use_when: You want to build an in-app file explorer or directory navigator in Flutter.
You need to list files and folders and allow users to open directories or pick files.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms without full support like MacOS or Windows, where support is currently missing or in progress.
You only need to pick a single file or media item using native system pickers.
strengths: Easy integration with standard Flutter list views via a builder and snapshot pattern.
Includes built-in sorting capabilities (by name, type, date, and size).
Provides a ControlBackButton widget to easily manage system back button behavior in subdirectories.
weaknesses: Windows and MacOS support are not fully implemented or have active issues.
Requires manual native permission configuration for Android storage access.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding storage permissions (WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) and requestLegacyExternalStorage to AndroidManifest.xml, alongside runtime permission requests.
